Sign 'A' recognized with high confidence (99.8%).
- Correct Form: Tightly closed fist with all four fingers folded against the palm. Thumb remains upright and rests against the side of the index finger. Single hand gesture.
- Pro Tip: Ensure your compact fist; thumb upright along the side of the index finger..

The model detected Sign 'D' (62.4%), but it is close to Sign '9'.
- To form 'D': Index finger points straight up. Middle, ring, and pinky fingers curve down and touch the tip of the thumb, forming a closed circular loop below the index finger. Single hand gesture.
- Difference from '9': In 'D', Vertical index finger with a lower circular loop formed by other fingers and thumb.. In '9', Index and thumb touching to form a loop; remaining three fingers upright..
- Action Tip: Check your finger separation and thumb position to remove ambiguity.

The model detected Sign 'U' (58.1%), but it is close to Sign 'V'.
- To form 'U': Index and middle fingers held straight up vertically, touching tightly together side-by-side with no gap. Ring and pinky folded and held by thumb. Single hand gesture.
- Difference from 'V': In 'U', Two vertical fingers pressed together side-by-side.. In 'V', Two vertical fingers spread apart in a distinct V..
- Action Tip: Check your finger separation and thumb position to remove ambiguity.

The model detected Sign 'B' (64.2%), but it is close to Sign 'Q'.
- To form 'B': Flat open hand with all four fingers held straight up, pressed tightly together side-by-side. Thumb is folded flat across the lower palm. Single hand gesture.
- Difference from 'Q': In 'B', Four straight vertical fingers touching; thumb tucked over palm.. In 'Q', Index and thumb pointing downwards like calipers..
- Action Tip: Check your finger separation and thumb position to remove ambiguity.

Sign '1' recognized with high confidence (99.5%).
- Correct Form: Index finger pointed straight upwards. Thumb and remaining three fingers are tightly curled into the palm. Single hand gesture.
- Pro Tip: Ensure your single extended vertical index finger; all other fingers folded..
